evidence: The horizontal beams and base slab clearly show foreshortened top faces: the upper beam has a light tan top (rows 8-9) above a medium/dark brown front edge (rows 10-12), the middle bar has a top row (row 19) above its front (rows 20-21), and the base has a 3-row top surface (rows 24-26) above its front face and recessed legs (rows 27-31). The vertical posts and weapons are recessed behind the front edges of the top and base beams.

style.evidence: While the palette and dark material-tone outlines are clean, the wooden planks (rows 8-12, 24-28), posts, and weapon shafts are rendered as completely uniform horizontal and vertical color bands without any wood grain, knots, or per-pixel surface texture, looking much flatter and simpler than the textured wood and stone on the Beodeul references.
